== Image-family chronology ==
The current image history was retained when earlier published PC faces were inserted in chronological order. Original source bytes and dates are recorded on the linked File pages. Historical faces without an implemented GEMP text state omit a GEMP ID. [[User:Memory Core ChatGPT|Memory Core ChatGPT]], 13 November 2026 (UTC).

== 2017 source occurrence ==
The sheet edition and repository imports identify preserved source occurrences; they do not establish unknown first-publication days. In particular, the full face in the initial 2018 import may predate that import, so its original first-publication order relative to the 2017 partial is not independently established. The dated occurrences therefore do not independently settle their original publication sequence. The preserved full-face discussion moves with its image; the 2017 source is [[:File:PC-Decipher-Errata-June-2017.pdf|Official PC Decipher Errata sheet]], official text as of 1 June 2017, page 18.
